chair.note: The seat is level, and its top is the lowest point of the seated body over the seat, with no shin, foot, or tail (seat_masks() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py). The front edge lies seatGap units behind the knee joint of the bind (the property seat of the armature), so that the calf does not reach over the seat. The half width holds the haunch (x -0.127 to 0.134 at y 0.33).

eyeBoxNote: The eye box holds the two loose eyeballs of the source (45 vertices each: x 0.018 to 0.055 on the left and -0.068 to -0.027 on the right, y 0.80 to 0.847, z 0.128 to 0.163). The nose box holds the dark nose tip (-0.004, 0.778, 0.254).
bodyNote: The facts of the body (BODY_FACTS of tools/studio-body.ts) beside the height: the crease angle 180, so that each corner takes the mean normal of the faces at its vertex, as the smooth shading of an FBX viewer shows the source.
metersPerUnitNote: The scale of the app. The hand rig keeps the form of the source, so only the scale of the whole body sets H. The fact height of the armature is the shoulder joints at this scale.
jointsNote: The places are the places of the source (tripo-p2/fox.fbx), mapped by the point edits of the hand rig (assets/models/fox/README.md). The source places are in the studio units and axes of the source pose: 1 unit from the soles to the ear tips, the soles at y = 0, +z forward, +x the left side. The FBX has no armature, so each joint comes from sections of the mesh and its edge loops. Arm (the mirror of the right arm, which the edit armEven gives the left arm too; closed loops of 14 vertices at x 0.153, 0.1735, and 0.1965, axis y 0.624 to 0.620, z 0.074 to 0.066): the shoulder at x 0.09, inside the arm root where the trunk side meets it, the elbow at x 0.168, in the middle of the loops at x 0.153 and 0.1835, the wrist at x 0.238, the narrowest place of the arm where the paw starts, the knuckles at x 0.295, at the clefts of the four digits, the tip at x 0.333. Leg: the source legs are not mirrors, so each side has its own joints, on the middles of the closed leg loops of 12 vertices (y 0.067 to 0.257): the hip in the haunch at y 0.30, the knee at y 0.165, the ankle at y 0.067, the ball of the foot at z 0.12, and the toe tips at z 0.165. Trunk: the waist is narrowest at y 0.53 (x 0.088), the haunch widest at y 0.31 to 0.33 (x 0.13), and the neck narrowest at y 0.71. Ears: the root at y 0.9, the tips at (0.104, 1.0, 0.055) on the left and (-0.13, 0.997, 0.055) on the right. Tail: a part of the body, from its root loop of 18 vertices at (0, 0.329, -0.048) back and down to its tip at (0, 0.071, -0.228).
